title: Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer
description: End-to-end ownership of the device firmware stack on Espressif ESP32: schematic review, board bring-up, production firmware, OTA, and Matter protocol certification. Independent contractor, ~$60/hr, 30-40 hrs/week. No desktop/GUI work mentioned.

title: STM32 firmware contractor (C/C++, FreeRTOS)
description: Design and implement embedded firmware in C/C++ for STM32L4/F4 microcontrollers with FreeRTOS or Zephyr RTOS. Deliverables: documented source, build and flash instructions, hardware test notes, architecture rationale.

title: Firmware engineer + existing C# companion app maintenance
description: Firmware updates for an ARM Cortex embedded device, plus gaining a full understanding of the existing C# desktop application and its device interface to extend configuration features over USB.

title: WPF desktop application developer
description: Design and build modern Windows desktop application UIs in C#, XAML and MVVM using Visual Studio and third-party UI libraries. Pure desktop software, no embedded/hardware component.

title: ESP32 BLE sensor firmware freelancer
description: ESP32 firmware for a Bluetooth Low Energy sensor product using ESP-IDF/Arduino. Sensor drivers and BLE stack. No desktop tool required for this engagement.

title: Embedded device with Windows configuration & calibration tool
description: STM32 firmware plus a companion Windows WPF application to configure and calibrate the device over serial/USB and display live sensor data. Both embedded and desktop skills required.

title: Remote full-stack web developer (React/Node)
